evaluation: Author-side AI reads actual reports against preregistered acceptance. No human or third-party scientific review. No answer key supplied to independent runs. No fabricated score.
controls: Same task, original PDF, CLI defaults, base tools and budget; fresh ephemeral session/directories; no cross-session artifacts. With alone gets frozen skill. No network or other models in reading task. Full raw records retained. Exact service model snapshot unavailable.
stopping_rule: Run first independent A pair, inspect actual quality/overhead before remaining runs. Proceed only for observable benefit or an explicitly disclosed bounded followup. Do not select best runs or change frozen skill and call it same-version replication.
proposed_gate: Useful substantive omission/error reduction, or lower time/output effort at equal reading quality. A25% time saving is a local decision target, not a contest rule; repeated pairs needed before stable-gain claims.
